# Apify Public Data MCP

> One MCP server exposing 39 public-data extraction tools. Each tool runs an Apify Actor on the
> caller's own Apify account and returns JSON rows: business leads, jobs, corporate and government
> records, research and health data, and media. Install with `uvx apify-data-scrapers`; set
> `APIFY_TOKEN`. MIT licensed.

## Use-case guides

- [SEC EDGAR filings](https://apify.revenuesystemslabs.com/mcp/sec-edgar/): filings by ticker or company, with forms and document URLs.
- [Google Maps data and business leads](https://apify.revenuesystemslabs.com/mcp/google-maps/): businesses with phone, website, rating and address.
- [Public records](https://apify.revenuesystemslabs.com/mcp/public-records/): state business registries, contractor licences, healthcare providers, GLEIF, French SIRENE.
- [Job search](https://apify.revenuesystemslabs.com/mcp/job-search/): LinkedIn and Glassdoor public postings.
- [US government data](https://apify.revenuesystemslabs.com/mcp/government-data/): USAspending, FEC, EPA, Census geocoding, CMS, openFDA, ClinicalTrials.gov.
